When you say “catheter drainage failure,” what kind of catheter is it (urinary Foley/suprapubic, nephrostomy, peritoneal drain, dialysis catheter, etc.), and what was it placed for?

Also: when did the severe lower abdominal pain and shortness of breath start (sudden vs gradual), and do you have any fever/chills or inability to pass urine/gas?

message.content: It’s a urinary catheter that goes into my continent urinary pouch through my catheterizable stoma. It was put in to keep the pouch draining all the time because I’d been having more and more trouble catheterizing for a few weeks. The drainage stopped working the night before I came in, and my urine output went down. After that I got severe lower belly pain and my breathing got progressively worse. I don’t know about fever or chills, and I don’t remember about passing gas.
